results: Requirement F19 fully implemented: New trust set is operator-controlled; removed key cannot activate an old signed bundle.
KeyRotationManager and StorageKeyStateStore implemented in internal/bundles/keys.go with durable atomic persistence via ADR-0003 storage.Adapter (record policyhelix:trust-keyring-state).
Operator authorization and private scope security gate enforced before any trust set mutation or operation replay via storage.ValidateIdentityAndScope.
Removed key IDs are permanently tracked in durable trust state; any attempt to activate an old or newly signed bundle with a removed key is rejected with REMOVED_SIGNER_KEY_REJECTED.
Monotonic bundle revision floor (HighestRevision) is preserved across trust key rotations and process restarts, preventing any rollback gap when rotating to a new signing key.
Emergency removal of the active bundle's signer key without a successor bundle immediately deactivates in-memory authority and fails closed on private resources.
Engine CLI flag -rotate-keys and HTTP endpoints (/api/v1/bundles/keys/rotate, /api/v1/bundles/keys/state) registered in cmd/policyhelix/main.go and proxied through scripts/serve-web.mjs.
Eight Apache-2.0 synthetic fixtures cataloged with SHA-256 digests in tests/fixtures/policyhelix/C25/manifest.json and verified in tests/key_rotation_test.go.
